reason: The cargo mesh and service tool may make a support that gives the potato stems room to grow, matching the current goal.
expectation: I expect to shape the mesh into some kind of plant support, though I don't know the exact result.

alternatives.reason: Harvesting the ready lettuce is physically natural, but I want to address the stated potato goal first.

effect: The mesh became a plant support cage, so I can now fit it to the potato trough.
reaction: The result matches what I expected, which is reassuring.
reason: Adding the cage to the potato trough seems like the direct way to give the stems room to grow.
expectation: I expect the cage to support the growing potato stems, though I don't know exactly how it will fit.

alternatives.reason: The lettuce is ready to harvest, but I want to finish the potato support first.

effect: The potato trough is supported, and the new goal is to taste the first harvest.
reaction: The image of tubers still forming makes the wait for potatoes feel tangible.
reason: Harvesting the lettuce is the only offered combination and directly serves the new goal.
expectation: I expect to cut some lettuce for the first harvest, though it may need another step before tasting.

effect: The scissors produced fresh lettuce leaves, ready for the next step toward tasting the harvest.
reaction: It is satisfying to have the first leaves after waiting for the crop to grow.
reason: Taking the leaves to the galley is the only offered combination and seems like the natural way to prepare them for tasting.
expectation: I expect to prepare or taste the lettuce at the galley, though the exact result is uncertain.

effect: The lettuce became a first fresh meal, completing the harvest goal.
reaction: The sharp green smell against the barren view makes the harvest feel rewarding.

mostWorthwhile.text: Preparing the first fresh meal was most worthwhile: the sensory detail made the long wait for the crop feel tangible.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the support cage was straightforward and had little detail on its own.

surprise.text: The supported potato trough highlighted that the leaves are growing while the tubers still need time.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary; each had a clear connection to supporting the potatoes or harvesting lettuce.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the potatoes develop and what the expedition discovers, though this chapter offered few meaningful choices.
